summary: Tested Biblioteca Escolar RGB iteration 2 (JWT auth + Books CRUD + public/admin view split). Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass covering health, auth (login success, wrong password 401, nonexistent email 401, /auth/me with/without token, invalid token), links (GET public, POST/DELETE without token 401, POST invalid URL 400, full upsert/persist flow, idempotent delete), books (GET public returns 4 seeded, POST 401 without token, full admin create->update->delete with GET verification, update non-existent 404, double-delete 404). Frontend: All key flows verified via Playwright — homepage discrete shield visible, login modal opens/closes via ESC, admin login (admin@rgb.edu/admin123) shows 'Modo administrador activo' banner, discrete btn replaced by Gestionar Libros FAB, library modal in admin mode shows 8 materia inputs with save/go/trash, saving link succeeds and creates Go button, BooksManager opens with 4 seeded books, Nuevo creates book (count 4->5), Edit updates title, Delete with confirm removes card, ESC closes BooksManager, Salir logs out and restores discrete shield, public library view shows 0 inputs / 1 'Ir' button for linked materia / 7 'No disponible' badges for unlinked materias.

issues: Console warning: empty string passed to img src attribute. Likely rendered when book.cover is '' (default in BookBase). Consider conditional rendering of or fallback src. Non-blocking.

action_items: Minor (optional): conditionally render cover in BookCard / BooksManager when book.cover is empty to avoid browser warning about empty src attribute.

Minor (optional): admin-books-manager-btn FAB at bottom-right overlaps with the 'Made with Emergent' preview badge; real-click (non-JS) may be intercepted in automated tests but works in normal browser. No user-facing issue in production.

Optional: /api/links DELETE of non-existent resource still returns 200 {deleted: 0} (inherited from iteration 1). /api/books DELETE of non-existent correctly returns 404. Consider aligning semantics if desired (not required).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login() sets cookie with secure=true and samesite='none'. This requires HTTPS (works on preview URL) but will silently not set cookie on plain HTTP — frontend Bearer token fallback covers this, good.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan context manager.
POST /api/links still accepts URLs starting with '/' (relative). Spec says http/https only; harmless.
No brute-force/lockout on /api/auth/login (auth_testing.md mentions lockout after 5 fails). Not implemented. Acceptable for MVP; flag if playbook requires it.
JWT_SECRET is stored in backend/.env (good). Password hashing uses bcrypt with $2b$ format (verified via verify_password). Seed admin is idempotent and updates password if changed — good.
BookBase defaults author/category/cover/url/description to empty string; BookUpdate correctly filters None so partial updates work (verified by test).
BooksManager modal does not have a visible overlay click-to-close; only ESC and X button close it. Acceptable UX.
FeaturedBooks category filter uses books from useLibrary() (MongoDB) — confirmed; no mock data.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-clean test_matematicas/test_lengua links under g1 via fixtures (use admin token). UI test created/edited/deleted 'TEST Book UI' book within same session; cleaned test link saved on g1/mat via curl DELETE after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 21 backend pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_library_api.py pass (classes TestHealth, TestAuth, TestLinks, TestBooks). Frontend Playwright flow verified end-to-end. Admin FAB admin-books-manager-btn is at fixed bottom-right z=30 and can be slightly overlapped by Emergent preview badge — use page.evaluate('el.click()') or force=True if needed. Public view uses materia-go-{id} + materia-empty-{id} test ids (no input in public). Admin view adds materia-input-{id} / materia-save-{id} / materia-remove-{id}. BooksManager uses admin-book-{id} for card, admin-book-edit-{id}, admin-book-delete-{id}. Delete uses window.confirm — auto-accept via page.once('dialog', d: d.accept()).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Iteration 2 implementation (JWT auth + Books CRUD + admin/public split) is working correctly across backend and frontend.
